asked.item: Why the Facebook Page is missing from the Duplicate account list
Am I missing a step in Duplicate
Setting up the same automation on the Facebook Page

verdict.reason: The sentences state that Duplicate only copies to accounts on the same platform, and they explain how to create a new automation for a Facebook Page.

steps.text: You are not missing a step: Duplicate only lets you copy an automation to accounts on the same platform, so a Facebook Page will not appear in that list.
Connect the Facebook Page through Accounts first.
Go to Automations, then select New automation.
Select the Facebook Page, enter a Flow name, then select Create flow.
A follow gate runs on Instagram only, so it is not available for a Facebook Page automation.
